meta.label: Week 8
meta.source_note: Reconstructed from the model's walk-forward backtest (predictions made with data available before kickoff)
meta.prices_et: Action Network, last stored pre-game price at each book

models.receptions: Hierarchical: Negative Binomial volume × shrunk efficiency
models.rec_yds: Hierarchical: Negative Binomial volume × shrunk efficiency

calibration.note: Temperature on the log-odds, fit walk-forward on earlier 2026 weeks only.

rules: Edge of 3+ points over the break-even of the best price, after dropping any book whose no-vig price sits more than 8 points from the others.
No out-of-distribution flag (fewer than 3 prior games, returning from absence, QB change, new QB, features outside the training range).
At most 15 bets, the largest edges, 1u each.
not_applied: Game-bootstrap interval test (bootstrap refits were not stored for past weeks)
meta.edge_rule: Edge = model chance minus the break-even of the best price, in points; an edge prop is 3+ points.

published.note: The slate actually posted for Week 8 (older v2.3 model, 44 props, partial board). History shows the richer walk-forward reconstruction; the posted slate stays under Slates.
